hook: Flight cancelled? This 10 min AI agent
writes your refund request for you

caption.ig:
Airline cancelled your flight and offered a voucher? Under U.S. DOT rules you can usually turn it down and ask for your money back. This agent reads the booking and drafts the request for you to send. Sample booking shown. Comment REFUND and I'll send you the free guide.
